name: Create Galore Field Guide
description:
A field guide to Create Galore. It explains how things work and how the mods connect. It won't tell you what to do next, with one exception: the road to space, the pack's capstone.

Just spawned? Read [#](2E5AAC)[Your First Days](entry://start_here/first_days)[#]() first: it covers drinking, clean water and staying warm.

New to Create? Start with [#](2E5AAC)[Create: The Basics](entry://create_basics/rotation)[#]().

Each section is a map: follow the arrows back to see what comes first. The magnifying glass searches every page.
